gaps.sentence: ___ contrast to her sister, she loves publicity.
The proposal was rejected ___ a single vote.
gaps.explanation: 'by a single vote / by two goals' — the margin takes 'by'.

gaps.sentence: She signed the confession ___ duress, according to her lawyers.
gaps.explanation: 'Under duress' = as a result of pressure or threats.

gaps.sentence: The play closed after three nights ___ account of poor ticket sales.
gaps.explanation: 'On account of' = because of, in a formal register.

gaps.sentence: ___ comparison with last year, sales have doubled.
The castle dates ___ to the fourteenth century.
Profits rose ___ 40 per cent, far beyond even the optimistic forecasts.
gaps.explanation: 'By' expresses the size of the increase: rose by 40 per cent.

gaps.sentence: The refugees were admitted ___ the country on humanitarian grounds.
